senses.gloss:
अश्व 1. अश्व, अस्, m. (rt. 1. अश्?), a horse,
especially a stallion; the number ‘seven’ (that being
the number of the horses of the sun); a race of men
horse-like in strength; N. of a son of Citraka, also
of a Dānava; (आ), f. a mare; (औ), du. a horse and
a mare [cf. Zend aśpa; Lat. equus; Gr. ἵππος
Lith. aszwa; Old Sax. ehuscalc].
—अश्व-कन्दिका,
f., N. of the plant Physalis Flexuosa.
—अश्व-कर्ण, अस्,
m. the ear of a horse; N. of the tree Vatica Robusta
W. and A., so called from the shape of its leaves;
a term in surgery for a particular fracture of the
bones; N. of a mountain.
—अश्व-कर्णक, अस्, m. =
the preceding in all but its last sense.
—अश्व-कुटी, f.
a stable for horses.
—अश्व-कुशल or अश्व-कोविद,
अस्, आ, अम्, skilled in horses.
—अश्व-क्रन्द, अस्,
m., N. of a bird.
—अश्व-खुर, अस्, m. a horse's
hoof; a perfume, apparently a dried shell-fish; (आ or
ई), f. the plant Clitoria Ternatea Lin.
—अश्व-गति,
इस्, f. the pace of a horse; N. of a metre containing
four verses of sixteen syllables each.
—अश्व-गन्धा,
f. the plant Physalis Flexuosa Lin.
—अश्व-गोयुग,
अम्, n. a pair of horses.
—अश्व-गोष्ठ, अम्, n. a
stable.
—अश्व-ग्रीव, अस्, m. ‘horse-neck,’ N. of a
demon, a foe of Viṣṇu, more commonly called Haya-
grīva.
—अश्व-घाम, अस्, m., N. of a place.
—अश्व-
घास, अस्, m. pasture for horses.
—अश्व-घोष,
अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist.
—अश्व-घ्न, अस्, m.
‘horse-bane,’ N. of a kind of Oleander, Nerium
Odorum Ait.
—अश्व-चलन-शाला, f. a riding-house.
—अश्व-चिकित्सक, अस्, m. a farrier, a veterinary sur-
geon.
—अश्व-चिकित्सा, f. farriery.
—अश्व-जघन,
अस्, m. a kind of centaur, a being with lower limbs like
those of a horse.
—अश्व-जित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. gaining
horses by conquest; (त्), m., N. of a Buddhist
Bhikṣu.
—अश्व-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a place of
pilgrimage near Kānyakubja on the Gaṅgā.
—अश्व-
द, अस्, आ, अम्, giving horses.
—अश्व-दंष्ट्रा, f.
the plant Tribulus Lanuginosus Lin.
—अश्व-दा, आस्,
m., Ved. or अश्व-दावन्, आ, m., Ved. giving horses.
—अश्व-दूत, अस्, m. a riding messenger.
—अश्व-
नदी, f., N. of a river.
—अश्व-नाय, अस्, m. a horse-
herd, i. e. one who has the charge of a drove of
grazing horses.
—अश्व-निबन्धिक, अस्, m. lit. ‘a
horse-fastener,’ a groom.
—अश्व-निर्णिज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved.
decorated or embellished with horses.
—अश्व-प, अस्,
m., Ved. a groom.
—अश्व-पति, इस्, m., Ved. lord
of horses; N. of several persons, of a king of Madra
and father of Sāvitrī; and of an Asura.
—अश्व-
पर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having horses for wings.
—अश्व-पस्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having horses for
(its) home or seat or source, consisting in horses (?),
depending on horses (?).
—अश्व-पाद, अस्, आ, अम्,
horse-footed.
—अश्व-पाल, अस्, m. a groom.
—अश्व-
पुच्छी, f. the plant Glycine Debilis Ait.
—अश्व-
पृष्ठ, अम्, n. horseback.
—अश्व-पेशस्, आस्, आस्,
अस्, Ved. decorated or embellished with horses.
—अश्व-बडव or अश्व-वडव, अम्, n. horses.
and mares; (औ), m. du. a horse and a mare.
—अश्व-बन्ध, अस्, m. lit. ‘a horse-fastener,’ a
groom, an ostler.
—अश्व-बन्धन, अम्, n. fasten-
ing of horses; (अस्, ई, अम्), used for fastening horses.
—अश्व-बला, f., N. of a vegetable.
—अश्व-बाल or
अश्व-वाल, अस्, m. tail or hair of a horse; a kind
of reed, Saccharum Spontaneum Lin.
—अश्व-बाहु,
उस्, m., N. of a son of Citraka.
—अश्व-बुध्न, अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. based on horses, having its origin in
horses, standing on horses, i. e. on a carriage drawn
by horses.
—अश्व-बुध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. based
on horses, having its origin in horses (as wealth),
distinguished by horses.
—अश्व-भा, f. lightning.
—अश्व-महिषिका, f. the natural enmity of a
horse and a buffalo.
—अश्व-मार or अश्व-मारक,
अस्, or अश्व-हन्तृ, ता, m. ‘horse-destroying,’ a
kind of Oleander, Nerium Odorum.
—अश्व-माल,
अस्, m. a kind of serpent.
—अश्वम्-इष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ,
[]
Ved. seeking or wishing for horses; procuring
horses, an epithet of Agni; (Sāy.) whose rites are
pervasive, or who desires quick worship.
—अश्व-
मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, having the head or countenance
of a horse; (अस्), m. a Kinnara or celestial chorister
(so represented); according to others, a kind of
demi-god distinct from the preceding; N. of a pe-
culiar race of people.
—अश्व-मुच्, क्, m. a horse-
stealer.
—अश्व-मेध, अस्, m. the horse-sacrifice;
(a celebrated ceremony, the antiquity of which
reaches back to the Vedic period. For example,
hymns 162 and 163 in the first Maṇḍala of the
Ṛg-veda were used at this sacrifice. In later times
its efficacy was so exaggerated, that a hundred such
sacrifices entitled the sacrificer to displace Indra from
the dominion of Svarga; kings who engaged in it
spent enormous sums in gifts to the Brāhmans. It
is said that the horse was sometimes not immolated,
but kept bound during the ceremony); N. of a son of
Bharata.
—अश्वमेध-काण्ड, अम्, n., N. of the
thirteenth book of the Śatapatha-Brāhmaṇa.
—अश्व-
मेध-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of a king.
—अश्वमेधिक
or अश्वमेधीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the horse-
sacrifice; (अस्), m. a horse fit for the sacrifice, called
Aśva-medha.
—अश्व-युज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. harnessing
horses; having horses put to (as a carriage); (क्), f.,
N. of a constellation, the head of Aries; the first
lunar mansion; m. the month Āśvina (Sept. — Oct.);
(क्, क्, क्), born under the constellation Aśvayuj.
—अ-
श्व-युज, अस्, m. the month Āśvina.
—अश्व-यूप,
अस्, m., Ved. the post to which the sacrificial horse
was bound.
—अश्व-योग, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. causing
the yoking of horses, joining or reaching as quickly
as horses.
—अश्व-रक्ष, अस्, m. the keeper or rider
of a horse, a groom.
—अश्व-रथ, अस्, m. a carriage
drawn by horses; (आ), f., N. of a river.
—अश्व-
राधस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. furnishing horses.
—अश्व-
रोधक, अस्, m., N. of the plant Nerium Odorum
Ait.
—अश्व-ललित, N. of a species of the Vikṛti
metre.
—अश्व-लाला, f. a kind of snake.
—अश्व-
लोमन्, आ, m. horse-hair; a kind of snake.
—अश्व-
वक्त्र, अस्, m. a Kinnara or Gandharba.
—अश्व-
वडव, अम्, n. a stud of horses and mares;
(औ), m. du. a horse and a mare; (आस्), m. horses
and mares, see अश्व-बडव. — 1. अश्व-वत्, ind. like
a horse.
—२. अश्व-वत्, or Ved. अश्वा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
possessed of horses, consisting of horses.
—अश्व-
वदन, अस्, m., N. of a people.
—अश्व-वह, अस्,
m. a horseman.
—अश्व-वार or अश्व-वाल, अस्, m.
a horseman, a groom.
—अश्व-वारक, अस्, m. a
horseman, a groom.
—अश्व-वारण, अस्, m., N. of
the Bos Gavæus.
—अश्व-वाह or अश्व-वाहक,
अस्, m. a horseman.
—अश्व-विक्रयिन्, ई, m. a
horse-dealer.
—अश्व-विद्, त्, त्, त्, skilled in taming
horses, an epithet of Nala; a jockey; Ved. procuring
horses.
—अश्व-वृष, अस्, m., Ved. a stallion.
—अश्व-वैद्य, अस्, m. a farrier, a veterinary surgeon.
—अश्व-शक, अम्, n., Ved. excrements of a horse.
—अश्व-शकृत्, त्, n. excrements of a horse, horse-
dung; N. of a river.
—अश्व-शङ्कु, उस्, m., N. of
a Dānava.
—अश्व-शाला, f. a stable.
—अश्व-शाव, अस्,
m. a foal, a colt.
—अश्व-शास्त्र, अम्, n. a manual
or text-book of veterinary science.
—अश्व-शिरस्,
अस्, n. a horse's head; (आस्, आस्, अस्), having the head
of a horse, an epithet of Nārāyaṇa; (आस्), m., N. of
a Dānava.
—अश्व-शृगालिका, f. the natural enmity
between the horse and the jackal.
—अश्व-श्चन्द्र,
अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. causing joy (by means of) horses;
brilliant with horses.
—अश्व-षङ्गव, अम्, n. a set
or team of six horses.
—अश्व-सनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. or
अश्व-सा or अश्व-षा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. gaining or
procuring horses.
—अश्व-साद, अस्, or अश्व-सादिन्,
ई, m. a horseman, a rider, a horse-soldier.
—अश्व-
सारथ्य, अम्, n. management of horses and cars,
horsemanship and driving, coachmanship, charioteer-
ship.
—अश्व-सूक्ति, इस्, m., N. of an author of Vedic
hymns.
—अश्व-सूनृत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. praised
sincerely for (the gift of) horses; whose praise for
(giving) horses is agreeable and true.
—अश्व-सेन,
अस्, m., N. of a Nāga.
—अश्वसेन-नृप-नन्दन,
अस्, m., N. of a king and saint, also Sanatkumāra.
[]
—अश्वस्तोमीय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. relating to the
praise of the sacrificial horse.
—अश्व-स्थान, अम्,
n. a stable or stall for horses; (अस्, आ, अम्),
born in a stable.
—अश्व-हय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
driving or spurring a horse.
—अश्व-हारक, अस्,
m. a horse-stealer.
—अश्व-हृदय, अम्, n. horse-
manship.
—अश्वाक्ष (˚व-अक्˚), अस्, m., N. of
a plant.
—अश्वाजनी (˚व-अज्˚), f. a whip.
—अश्व-
धिक (˚व-अध्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, strong in cavalry,
superior in horses.
—अश्वाध्यक्ष (˚व-अध्˚), अस्,
m. a guardian of horses.
—अश्वा-मघ, अस्, ई, अम्,
Ved. rich in horses.
—अश्वायुर्-वेद (˚व-आय्˚), अस्,
m. veterinary science.
—अश्वारि (˚व-अरि), इस्, m. a
buffalo.
—अश्वारूढ (˚व-आर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, mounted,
sitting on horseback.
—अश्वारोह (˚व-आ˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
riding or mounted on a horse; (अस्), m. a horseman;
(आ), f., N. of the plant Aśvagandhā.
—अश्वारोहक
(˚व-आर्˚), अस्, m., N. of the plant Aśvagandhā.
—अश्वारोहिन् (˚व-आर्˚), ई, इणी, इ, mounted or
riding on horseback.
—अश्वा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, fur-
nished with horses.
—अश्वावरोहक (˚व-अव्˚), अस्,
m., N. of the plant Aśvagandhā.
—अश्वेषित (˚व-
इष्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, hurried along by horse.
—अश्वोरस
(˚व-उर्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, broad-chested like a horse.
2. अश्व, nom. P. अश्वति, to behave like a horse.

अस्व अ-स्व, अस्, आ, अम्, or अ-स्वक, अस्, अका
or इका, अम्, or अ-स्वकीय, अस्, आ, अम्, not one's
own, belonging to another.
—अ-स्व-ग, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. not going to one's own home, homeless.
—अ-
स्वग-ता, f., Ved. homelessness.
—अ-स्व-जाति, इस्, इस्,
इ, of a different caste, of a different species.
—अस्व-
त्व, अम्, n. or अस्व-ता, f. want of claim or right to
anything, having no indefeasible property in it, ab-
sence of ownership.

आश्व आश्व, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अश्व), relating or
belonging to a horse, equestrian, coming from a horse
(e. g. आश्वम् मूत्रम्, ‘the urine of a horse’); drawn
by horses (e. g. आश्वो रथः, ‘a chariot drawn by
horses’); (अम्), n. a number of horses, a chariot
drawn by horses; the state or action of a horse.
—आश्व-घ्न, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a man.

अश्वक, अस्, आ, अम्, horse-like, acting like a horse,
&c.; (अस्), m. a small horse; a bad horse, a hack; a
stray horse, one whose owner is not known; any horse.
अश्वकिनी, f. the first Nakṣatra or lunar mansion.

अश्वतर, अस्, आ, अम्, swift, speedy; (अस्, ई), m.
f. a mule; (अस्), m. a male calf; N. of a Gandharva;
one of the chiefs of the Nāgas or serpent-race, inha-
biting the regions under the earth.

आश्वतर, अस्, m. (fr. अश्व-तर), patronymic of
Buḍila (Bulila); a descendant of Aśvatara, son of
Aśva.

अश्वत्थ, अस्, m. the holy fig tree, Ficus Religiosa
L. (under which horses stand; त्थ = स्थ); Ved. a
vessel made of its wood; N. of another tree (= गर्द-
भाण्ड); the fruit of the Ficus Religiosa; the time at
which it bears; an epithet of the sun; N. of a man;
N. of a people; (आ), f. day of full moon in the month
Āśvina, in which month the fruits of the Ficus Re-
ligiosa generally become ripe; day of full moon; (ई),
f., N. of a plant.
—अश्वत्थ-कुण, अस्, m. the fruit
season of the holy fig tree.
—अश्वत्थ-भेद, अस्,
m., N. of a tree, Bignonia Suaveolens.

आश्वत्थ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अश्वत्थ), taken from
or made of the tree Ficus Religiosa; relating to the
fruit-bearing season of this tree; (अम्), n. the fruit
of the holy fig tree.

अश्वत्थक, अस्, आ, अम्, to be given or to be done
&c. when the Aśvattha tree bears; (अम्), n. the pe-
tals of the Arabian jasmine.

अश्वत्थामन्, आ, m. (त्थामन् for स्थामन् ?),
N. of a saint and warrior, the son of Droṇa and one
of the chiefs of the Kurus.
अश्वत्थिका, f., N. of a plant.

आश्वत्थिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to or produced by
the Aśvattha tree; relating to its fruit-bearing season.

अश्वय, nom. P. अश्वयति, -यितुम्, to wish for
horses.
अश्वया, f., Ved. desire to get horses.

अश्वाय, nom. P. अश्वायति, -यितुम्, Ved. to wish
for horses.
अश्वयु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. desiring horses.

अश्वल, अस्, m., N. of the Hotṛ-priest of Janaka,
king of Videha.

अश्वस्य, nom. P. अश्वस्यति, -यितुम्, to wish for
the stallion.

आ-श्वास्य, ind. having consoled, having cherished;
having recovered or revived.

अश्विक, अस्, ई, अम्, drawn by horses, carried by
horses.

आश्विक, अस्, ई, अम्, equestrian, cavalier, relating to
a horse, drawn by horses.

अश्विन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. possessed of horses, consist-
ing of horses; (ई), m. a cavalier, a horse-tamer;
(नौ), m. du. the two charioteers; N. of two divini-
ties, who appear in the sky before the dawn in a
golden carriage drawn by horses or birds; they bring
treasures to men and avert misfortune and sickness;
in later times they are considered as the physicians of
Svarga or heaven; (in astronomy) they are the twins
of the zodiac; (इनी), f. a nymph, considered in later
times as the mother of the Aśvins; she was the wife of
Sūrya or the sun, who concealed herself in the form of
a mare; (in astronomy) the head of Aries or the first
of the twenty-eight Nakṣatras or lunar mansions;
(इ), n., Ved. richness in horses.
—अश्वि-देवताक,
अस्, आ, अम्, whose divinities are the Aśvins.
—अश्विनी-
कुमार or अश्विनी-पुत्र or अश्विनी-सुत, औ, m. du.
the twin sons of Sañjñā, the sun's wife, in the form
of Aśvinī, commonly called the Aśvins.
—अश्वि-मत्,
[]
आन्, अती, अत्, (any Mantra &c.) containing the word
Aśvin.
—अश्वि-सालोक्य, अम्, n. the heaven or station
of the Aśvins, to which the giver of a horse is raised.

अश्विय, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. referring to horses; (आ),
Ved. neut. pl. a troop of horses.

अश्वीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging or relating to a
horse, conducive to horses; (अम्), n. a number of
horses.
आश्वीय, अम्, n. a number of horses.

अश्वीन, अस्, आ, अम्, distant a day's journey for a
horse; more usually आश्वीन.

आश्विन, अस्, ई, अम्, (if fr. 1. अश्विन्) Ved. like
riders; belonging to or devoted to the Aśvins; (if fr.
rt. 1. अश्, to pervade), pervading, penetrating; (अस्),
m., N. of a month of the rainy season, during which
the moon is near to the constellation Aśvinī; (ई), f.,
N. of certain (इष्टका), bricks; (अम्), n. a day's
journey for a horse or rider.

आश्वीन, अस्, ई, अम्, passed over by a horse in one
day; (अम्), n. a day's journey for a horse.

अश्व्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to or coming
from horses; consisting of horses; (अम्), n., Ved. a
number of horses, possession of horses; (अस्), m., N.
of Vaśa, the son of Aśva.

अश्वन्त अश्वन्त, अम्, n. (connected with
अश्मन्त, q. v.), death; a field; a fire-place; ter-
mination, limit; (अस्, आ, अम्), unlucky, inauspicious,
unbounded, unlimited. [In the first sense अश्वन्त
may be for असु-अन्त, ‘end of life.’]

अस्वन्त अ-स्वन्त (अ-सु-अन्त), अस्, आ, अम्,
ending ill, leading to or having an unfavourable issue;
(fr. असु-अन्त ?) approaching the end of life; a fire-
place, see अश्वन्त.

अश्वस्तन अ-श्वस्तन, अस्, ई, अम्, or अ-श्वस्त-
निक, अस्, आ, अम्, of to-day, not of or not for to-mor-
row; one who makes no provision for to-morrow.
—अ-श्वस्तन-विद्, त्, त्, त्, ignorant of the future.

अ-स्वच्छन्द, अस्, आ, अम्, docile; not self-willed,
dependant.

अ-स्वतन्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, not self-willed, dependant,
subject; docile, humble.

अ-स्वभाव, अस्, m. unnatural or unusual character
or temperament; (अस्, आ, अम्), of a different nature.

अ-स्वरूप, अस्, आ, अम्, essentially different or
unlike.

अ-स्ववेश, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having no home of
one's own, expelled from home.

अ-स्वाध्याय (˚स्व-अध्˚), अस्, m. a Brāhman
who has not performed his studies, who has not read
the Vedas previously to his investiture; interruption
or interval of study, prohibited on certain days of the
moon, at eclipses, &c.

अ-स्वार्थ (˚स्व-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, not for one's
self; not for a proper object; having a different
meaning.

अस्वार्थ अ-स्वार्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, unselfish,
disinterested.
अ-स्वीकार, अस्, m. non-acquiescence, dissent.

अ-स्वीकृत, अस्, आ, अम्, dissented from, refused,
not promised.

अस्वच्छ अ-स्वच्छ, अस्, आ, अम्, not clear,
opaque.

अस्वप्न अ-स्वप्न, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. sleepless,
awake; (अस्), m. sleeplessness, the being awake; a
god, a deity [cf. ἄϋπνος].
अ-स्वप्नज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. not sleepy, sleepless.

अस्वर अ-स्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, not aloud,
speaking in an under tone, indistinct; having a bad
or croaking voice; (अम्), ind. not aloud, in a low
tone, indistinctly.

अस्वर्ग्य अ-स्वर्ग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, not leading
to heaven, unheavenly.

अस्वस्थ अ-स्व-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, not in good
health, not one's self, sick.
—अस्वस्थ-ता, f. want of
firmness; weakness, illness.

अ-स्वास्थ्य, अम्, n. indisposition, sickness, dis-
comfort, indigence.
अस्वादु अ-स्वादु, उस्, उस्, उ, tasteless, insipid.

अस्वामिक अ-स्वामिक, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, un-
owned, unclaimed.

अ-स्वामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having no right or title to
anything, not being master of it; that which has no
master or owner.
—अ-स्वामि-विक्रय, अस्, m. sale
without ownership.

अ-स्वाम्य, अम्, n. absence of right or title to pro-
perty.

अस्वेद अ-स्वेद, अस्, m. suppressed perspira-
tion; (अस्, आ, अम्), not perspiring.

आश्वपेजिन्, इनस्, m. pl. (fr. अश्व-पेज), the pupils
or followers of Aśva-peja.

आश्वबल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अश्व-बला), produced
by the plant Aśva-balā.

आश्वबाल or आश्ववाल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अश्व-बाल),
made of the cane Aśva-bāla.

आश्वमेधिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अश्व-मेध), be-
longing to the horse-sacrifice; (आश्वमेधिकम्
पर्व is the N. of the fourteenth book of the Mahā-
bhārata.)

आश्वयुज, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अश्व-युज्), born under
the constellation Aśvayuj, belonging to or occurring
in the month Āśvina; (अस्), m. the month Āśvina;
(ई), f. the day of full moon in Āśvina.

आश्वयुजक, अस्, ई, अम्, sown at the day of full
moon in the month Āśvina.

आश्वरथ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अश्व-रथ), belonging
to a chariot drawn by horses.

आश्वलक्षणिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अश्व-लक्षण),
knowing the marks of horses; (अस्), m. a farrier,
a groom.

आश्वायन, अस्, m. (fr. अश्व + अयन), a descendant
of Aśva.

आश्विनेय, अस्, m. (a patronymic fr. अश्विनौ, the
fathers of the twins Nakula and Sahadeva), N. of
Sahadeva, the youngest of the Pāṇḍava princes; (fr.
their mother अश्विनी), an epithet of either of the two
Aśvins.
आश्वेय, अस्, m. a patronymic from Aśva.
आश्वपस् आश्व्-अपस्, &c. See under आशु.

आश्वलायन आश्वलायन, अस्, m. (patronymic
fr. अश्वल), N. of the author of a ritual work, called
the Āśvalāyana Sūtras; he was a disciple of Śaunaka;
(अस्, ई, अम्), belonging to Āśvalāyana.

आश्वस् आ-श्वस्, cl. 2. P. -श्वसिति, -सितुम्, to
breathe, breathe again, breathe freely, take breath,
recover breath, take heart or courage; to revive:
Caus. P. -श्वासयति, -यितुम्, to cause one to take
breath; to encourage, comfort, cheer up; to con-
ciliate.

आ-श्वसत्, अन्, अती, अत्, taking breath, breathing
anew; reviving; recovering.

आ-श्वसित, अस्, आ, अम्, encouraged, cheered, con-
soled.

आ-श्वासित, अस्, आ, अम्, encouraged, animated, com-
forted, consoled.

आ-श्वास, अस्, m. breathing again, taking breath,
breathing freely, recovery; cheering up, consolation;
a chapter or section, the division of a book; a pro-
bable story; cessation, completion.

आ-श्वासक, अस्, इका, अम्, consolatory, consoling,
comforting; (अस्), m. clothing.

आ-श्वासन, अम्, n. making or letting one take
breath, consoling, encouraging, reviving; cheering up.
आ-श्वासयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, encouraging, animating.

आ-श्वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, breathing freely, reviving, be-
coming cheerful; consoling.

आस्वद् आ-स्वद् or -स्वाद्, cl. 1. A. -स्वदते
or -स्वादते, -दितुम्, to taste, eat.

आ-स्वाद, अस्, आ, अम्, tasting, eating; (अस्), m.
tasting, enjoying, eating; flavour.
—आस्वाद-वत्, आन्,
अती, अत्, having a good taste, palatable; delicious in
flavour.
आ-स्वादक, अस्, इका, अम्, tasting, enjoying.
आ-स्वादन, अम्, n. tasting, enjoying, eating.

आ-स्वादित, अस्, आ, अम्, tasted, enjoyed, possessed;
eaten.

आ-स्वाद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be tasted or enjoyed,
to be eaten; having a good taste, palatable, delicious.
—आस्वाद्य-तोय, अस्, आ, अम्, having sweet or palata-
ble water.

आस्वन् आ-स्वन्, cl. 1. P. -स्वनति, -नितुम्,
to sound.
आ-स्वनित or आ-स्वान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded.
अश्व-षङ्गव; correct thus — अश्व-षड्गव.
अश्व-सुक्ति; read — अश्व-सुक्तिन्, ई, m.
